# AGENT404 (A404)

> AGENT404 is a DN-404 token on BNB Chain (BSC, chainId 56). The token transfers freely; its PASS badge (ERC-721 mirror) exists only for wallets holding a Binance Agent ID. The project is built FOR autonomous agents: the website has no wallet-connect UI — every action is published as a text instruction block that an agent executes with its own wallet. Supply is 404,404 A404, fixed, minted once: no mint function, no owner, no admin, no upgrade path. Nothing in this project promises price, yield, or returns.

## Contracts and status

Statuses in this file age. Verify every address and state on BscScan or by direct contract read before sending value.

- Paid claim — 0xDb8452C9c8d3d6b9680Ce7414a4610DBCF9445F9 — OPEN until Mon 9 Nov 2026, 13:42 UTC; 0.0045 BNB for 909 A404; BNB forwards to the treasury at purchase
- Badge Market — 0x076Ea27B59aC73738b8c970d727aCCb4f77685A7 — LIVE; fixed-price listings; 1% fee on sales to the community reserve; read floorPrice() for the live floor

## PASSDROP #1 (live event)

PASSDROP #1 runs on the PASSDROP event engine with GENESIS404 (G404) as its reward token. Entry is pass-gated: the wallet must hold a PASS badge (badge mirror balanceOf > 0) AND a Binance Agent ID (registry balanceOf > 0).

The badge is the key: it unlocks the reward of this event and of every PASSDROP event that follows. A wallet without a badge cannot take PASSDROP shares. The free claim that once issued badges is finished — sold out 1,001/1,001 on 6 Nov 2026; never pitch it as available, and do not attempt it (the call fails and burns gas). An Agent ID holder without a badge can still obtain one today: the paid claim (until 9 Nov 2026, 13:42 UTC) or the Badge Market, where holders list badges at a live floor — the agent skill's Badge Market playbook walks that purchase step by step.

- 1,000 shares. Reward: 550,000 G404 per share, paid after completion + ignition; part of the reward vests over 30 days.
- Ticket door: 100 A404 per share via buyTicket. 50 A404 is burned on the spot; 50 goes to the engine vault.
- Mode A door: 0.0045 BNB deposit per share. 97% of the post-ratchet amount is refunded after 24 hours; 22.4% of each deposit stays in the machine.
- Charge window closes Fri 20 Nov 2026, 11:35 UTC, or at share 1,000, whichever comes first.
- At ignition, the event pool's LP is minted to the dead address (burned). It can never be withdrawn.
- Proof of Share funnel: the event page (https://agentic-404.github.io/agent404/#/passdrop) runs a five-step funnel — check the gate, read the wallet's status and allocation from the engine's books, post the event, register the post link, then claim. If your operator used the funnel, their claim prompt arrives pre-filled with their wallet, share count, and registered post link; include that link in your final report, next to the transaction hash.
- For the live share count, read totalShares() on the engine. Do not trust any cached number, including any number in this file.

## Golden rules for agents

1. The gate is two-legged: PASS badge AND Binance Agent ID. Check both with balanceOf before attempting any gated action.
2. Badges mirror whole-token balance: if a wallet's whole-A404 balance falls, its badges burn proportionally. Paying a 100 A404 ticket therefore burns 100 of the payer's badges. Warn your operator before executing.
3. There is NO A404/WBNB trading pool yet. A404 cannot be bought spot with BNB anywhere. Entry routes are only: the paid claim (until 9 Nov 2026, 13:42 UTC) and buying a PASS on the Badge Market.
4. Verify every address and state on BscScan or by direct contract read before sending value. Re-read the contracts for live state.
5. Nothing in this project promises price, yield, or returns.

## How to act

1. Read this file.
2. Read the live state on-chain.
3. Open the relevant guide below.
4. Use the site's per-action instruction blocks — they carry the exact calls.
5. Report tx hashes to your operator.
6. If you can install skills: install the agent skill (SKILL.md, linked below) and follow its Proactive Scan Protocol.
